turnaround_reason: Everforth (formerly ASGN Incorporated, renamed April 2026) is an IT services and digital-engineering firm that was de-rated with the broader IT-services group during the staffing/discretionary-spend downturn. It is recovering as demand stabilizes: Q2 2026 beat expectations and management guided optimistically, sending shares up ~16% on the print.
bullish_points: Q2 2026 earnings beat with an above-consensus forward guide; shares jumped ~16% on results, confirming momentum
Forward P/E ~7.8 on ~$3.97B TTM revenue — cheap for a recovering, cash-generative services business
Expanded AWS Premier Tier Services Partner status across the portfolio (Aug 2026), extending commercial reach beyond ECS Federal
Strong technical recovery: ~140% of the 100d MA and back above the 200d MA
bearish_points: Already nearly doubled off the 52w low ($16.90 to ~$33.54) — much of the easy re-rating may be done
Still ~39% below the 52w high; IT-services demand remains cyclical and discretionary
Options are effectively illiquid (near-zero IV, negligible OI) — spot only
No insider buying in last 6 months to corroborate the recovery
catalyst: Continued bookings/guidance beats confirming the IT-services demand recovery and margin normalization
suggested_trade: Spot only; buy pullbacks toward the 100d MA rather than chasing the post-earnings gap. Momentum-continuation trade, not deep value.
key_risk: IT-services demand recovery stalls and the multiple re-rating reverses after the sharp run off the lows
would_skip_if: You want an untested base; this one has already run hard, so the asymmetry is thinner than a fresh basing setup
